projects.name: TileLens
projects.one_liner: Reads a tile-game board off the screen and previews the best word plays, locally, in milliseconds.
decisions: Unclear tiles are flagged, never guessed
Fast search checked against a brute-force solver every test run
Overlay excluded from its own captures

results.claim: 2.2 ms median search on mid-game 13x13 boards, 204k-word list
457 tests pass in the CI subset; 565 test functions in all
results.source: uv run pytest -m "not gui and not slow"

results.claim: 99.9-100% of squares read on synthetic boards across five themes, zero silent errors
14/14 letters and values on real Discord rack captures, uncalibrated (two racks)

limits: macOS on Apple silicon only, one machine
Side project, not for ranked play; not affiliated with any game

projects.name: Pacer
projects.one_liner: Learned eviction for LLM prefix (KV) caches, tested on Alibaba's public Qwen production traces.
decisions: Train, validate and test on separate time windows; every look at the test hour logged
Tuned baselines, best one per cell picked with hindsight
Success criteria written before the build, misses published
Python reference simulator as an executable spec for the Rust one

results.claim: Chat trace, 2% cache, held-out hour: LRU 24.36%, S3-FIFO 26.26%, ATC'25 27.97%, Pacer 30.19%, Belady 55.16% hit ratio
Better than the best tuned heuristic in 13 of 16 trace x size cells, tied in 3, worse in 0
Live MLX replay: mean time to first token 1.2% lower than LRU (95% CI 0.1-2.4%)
8 Rust tests and 456 Python tests pass

limits: Trace-driven simulation, not a production deployment
Two hours per trace, one temporal split
No gain on chat at 5-10% cache

projects.name: Classmap
projects.one_liner: Your UC Santa Cruz class schedule on a campus map, including rooms the big map apps can't find.
decisions: No server, no account: data ships in the app
Dart port pinned to recorded Python outputs
Hands walking directions to the system maps app

results.claim: 87 of 87 official classrooms resolve to a building, room and position
401 Flutter, 31 web and 55 data-pipeline tests pass

limits: Tested in the iOS Simulator, not on a physical device
Not affiliated with UC Santa Cruz
